correctness.rationale: PASS: Expanding source PMF p_x = theta^4 q^x(x+1)(x²+A x+B)/[6(1+theta)^8] gives cubic count polynomial. Differentiating q^(x+1)/(1-q) with q d/dq three times yields exact strict-survival polynomial with corrected omega1=6 theta^7+36 theta^6+108 theta^5+174 theta^4+146 theta^3+45 theta²+6 theta; other coefficients unchanged. Difference from source omega1 is theta^4(5 theta³+30 theta²+90 theta+87). Exact symbolic calculation independently recovered all four polynomial coefficients, and exact rational recurrences S(x-1)-S(x)=p_x held theta=1,2,5,9 and x=1..19. The hazard at theta=5,x=2 is 1814375/1739338>1 printed vs corrected 1814375/2336838<1. The proof applies all theta>0, x nonnegative via analytic rational-generating function, not finite tests.
